title: Design System: Muhammad Abubakar — GitHub Profile

display.purpose: The name, set once in the banner with the phosphor glow filter.

label.purpose: Title-bar text and tech-stack line — lowest-emphasis register.

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.value: SMIL <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0;0;1" keyTimes="0;0.45;0.45;0.9;1" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite">
motion.purpose: The single moving element on the profile — an idle terminal cursor. GFM allows no CSS/JS, so motion is authored directly in the SVG via SMIL.

components.name: Terminal Banner
components.description: The profile's signature element: a macOS-style terminal window running `whoami`, themed for dark/light via prefers-color-scheme. Shipped as static SVG (assets/banner-dark.svg, assets/banner-light.svg); this HTML/CSS is an approximation for panel preview only.

components.css: .ds-terminal { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; background: #070B08; border: 1.5px solid #1F2A22; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 0 120px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); } .ds-terminal-titlebar { position: relative; height: 44px; background: #121712; border-bottom: 1px solid #1F2A22; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 8px; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-dot-red { background: #FF5F56; } .ds-dot-amber { background: #FFBD2E; } .ds-dot-green { background: #27C93F; } .ds-terminal-title { position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 14px; color: #1B6E3A; } .ds-terminal-body { padding: 24px 40px 32px; color: #1B6E3A; } .ds-prompt { font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-bright { color: #33FF66; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(51,255,102,0.6); } .ds-name { font-size: 46px; font-weight: 700; color: #33FF66; text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(51,255,102,0.65); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-role { font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-tagline { font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-stack { font-size: 15px; color: #145C33; margin-bottom: 18px; } .ds-cursor { display: inline-block; color: #33FF66; animation: ds-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0% { opacity: 1; } 45% { opacity: 1; } 46% { opacity: 0; } 90% { opacity: 0; } 91% { opacity: 1; } }

narrative.northStar: Green-Phosphor Terminal in a Midnight Machine Room
narrative.overview:
The profile is built on one governing idea: prove production competence through format, not adjectives. A recruiter shouldn't read claims about a system that ships and stays in production — they should land on a page that behaves like one: a live terminal session, near-black CRT ground, phosphor-green monospace, a whoami that answers in status-readout register. Nothing on the page performs enthusiasm; everything on the page reports.

This is a hard constraint of the medium as much as a choice — GitHub profile READMEs render static GFM only, no CSS, no JS, no live components. The world has to hold together with pre-rendered SVG and disciplined typographic hierarchy alone. So the terminal metaphor does double duty: it's the aesthetic and the excuse for staying static — a real terminal is mostly still, waiting at a prompt, which is exactly what a GFM page can honestly be.

Built from concept-seed direction 5 (CLI/terminal session), fused with the dealt challenger world "phosphor-terminal-midnight" (scanline glow, cursor bloom, P1 phosphor green #33FF66), seed key 9f37b2b5.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black CRT ground with a soft radial vignette, not flat black
One accent color, phosphor green, spent sparingly — most text sits in a dimmer green register
Real terminal chrome (macOS-style traffic lights, title bar) framing the content, not decorating it
The only motion on the entire page is a blinking cursor — a signature, not an effect
80-column / ≤36-character discipline in every fenced block, carried from the banner into the README body itself

rules.name: The One Bright Rule
rules.body: #33FF66 (or its light-mode counterpart #0F5132) touches exactly three things: the whoami keyword, the name text, and the cursor. Every other character on the banner sits in mid or dim green.

rules.name: The Column Discipline Rule
rules.body: Every line inside a fenced block — banner or README body — stays at or under 36 characters, to keep the terminal illusion from breaking into horizontal scroll on a 360px mobile GitHub view.

rules.name: The Bloom-Is-Earned Rule
rules.body: The glow filter is applied to exactly one element: the display-scale name. It is not a reusable hover/emphasis effect.

dos: Do keep the bright phosphor green to the three elements named in the One Bright Rule — name, whoami, cursor.
Do hold every fenced-block line to ≤36 characters (Column Discipline Rule).
Do write readout content as status/log lines, matching the terminal-scrollback register established by the banner.
Do keep both banner variants structurally in sync — only the palette should differ between them.
donts: Don't use ANSI-escape–colored fenced code blocks — GitHub does not render them in color.
Don't add a second typeface, drop shadow, gradient fill, or corner radius outside what's cataloged here.
Don't state a metric, claim, or project detail beyond what PRODUCT.md's verified LinkedIn-sourced list supports.
Don't apply the glow filter to more than the name text.
